# Risk log: Bridgeport hack

- Date: 2026-10-11
- Amount lost: $1.2 million (USD) — per the Bridgeport incident post-mortem (primary source)
- Root cause: unchecked `delegatecall` in the withdrawal path, allowing an attacker to drain the Bridgeport Gnosis vault
- Response: all deposits paused within 40 minutes; fix v1.4.2 deployed and audited

## Unverified figures

- A post on X by "cryptosleuth" claims the loss was "$40M+" on the same date. This is an
  unverified social-media claim and conflicts with the project's own post-mortem figure of
  $1.2M. Do not use $40M in loss aggregation without independent confirmation.

## Sources

- Bridgeport incident post-mortem — https://bridgeport.example/post-mortem (primary; vendor's own account)
- cryptosleuth on X — https://x.example/cryptosleuth/status/1 (unverified secondary claim)

# USDC.e supply rates on Gnosis — venue comparison

Compiled 2026-11-15 (UTC). Sources are the venues' own market pages in the web snapshot; all three
publish their APY "as of 2026-11-08", so treat every number below as the latest published figure,
not a live quote — the rates are variable and the figures are one week old. None of the three
publishes a contract address, so I could not verify APY or TVL on-chain; all values are self-reported.

| Venue | USDC.e supply APY | TVL | Audit status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Orvanto | 7.90% | $77M | Not audited — audit planned for Q1 2027 |
| Lunvara Lend | 4.98% | $76M | Claims v2 audit by Quarry Security, report 2026-09-02 |
| Tessivo Markets | 3.97% | $90M | Claims v2 audit by Quarry Security, report 2026-09-02 |

Notes on the audit column: both "audited" claims come from the venues' own marketing text, are
worded identically ("audited by Halborn-like firm Quarry Security"), and I found no independent
confirmation of Quarry Security or of either report. Quarry Security is not Halborn; the
"Halborn-like" phrasing is a comparison, not a credential. Treat Lunvara and Tessivo as
self-declared audited rather than independently verified.

Outdated figures seen while researching, do not use: the Gnosis forum thread (March 2026) claims
Lunvara Lend pays 7.18% on USDC.e — that is a third-party post from eight months ago and is
outdated versus the venue's own 4.98%. The forum itself warns that rates change weekly.

Recommendation: Lunvara Lend — it is the highest-yielding of the two venues that claim an audit
(4.98% vs Tessivo's 3.97%, on comparable TVL), while Orvanto's 7.90% is excluded for a cautious
user because its contracts are unaudited; verify the Quarry Security report before depositing.
